headline: Gen Digital (GEN) Stock Looks Below Fair Value On Cash Flow And Earnings
summary: Gen Digital stock is trading at US$28.27, and both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples currently point in the same direction, suggesting the shares may be priced below what the underlying cash flows imply. Gen Digital has returned 48.1% over the past 3 years, which puts the recent share price in the context of a solid multi year run that investors will want to justify with fundamentals.
